body:
## Pull request overview

Adds keyboard accessibility and visual-state refinements to the Dopemux Ultra UI dashboard: task metadata becomes keyboard-focusable with descriptive ARIA labels and explicit focus-visible styling, the current-task icon now toggles between an animated Play and a Pause icon based on timer state, and Live Signal Feed notification chips become focusable.

**Changes:**
- TaskSequencer metadata boxes (complexity/duration/energy/finish-time) become focusable with `aria-label` and custom `:focus-visible` rings.
- Current-task icon swaps to a `Pause` (Saint Gold) when `isTimerRunning` is false, retains pulsing `Play` (Ritual Cyan) when running.
- Notification chips in `App.tsx` made keyboard-focusable; `Accessibility.test.ts` updated to assert the new patterns.

### Reviewed changes

Copilot reviewed 3 out of 3 changed files in this pull request and generated no comments.

| File | Description |
| ---- | ----------- |
| ui-dashboard/src/components/TaskSequencer.tsx | Adds Pause/Play state toggle for current task icon; wraps metadata in focusable Boxes with ARIA labels and focus-visible styles. |
| ui-dashboard/src/App.tsx | Adds `tabIndex={0}` to signal-feed notification Chip for keyboard navigation. |
| ui-dashboard/src/components/__tests__/Accessibility.test.ts | String-based assertions for the new ARIA labels, focusability, and focus-visible styles. |
